name: Lothric
story: The First Flame gutters, and the Lords of Cinder, who were meant to link it, have abandoned their thrones. The kingdom of Lothric is dying and its knights are hollowing.
From the Cemetery of Ash to the High Wall, the land is filled with the hollowed, and with great champions who refuse to rest. The Fire Keeper waits in the Firelink Shrine.
You are an Unkindled, an ember that does not belong in the grave. Return the Lords to their thrones, and decide whether the flame burns on or fades.
ending: The Lords return to their thrones, and the bonfire roars. Whether the flame is linked or let fade is a decision for another age.

characters.name: Knight
characters.backstory: A knight of Lothric who lost his banner and kept his oaths.

characters.name: Herald
characters.backstory: A sunlit healer whose prayers are old, and whose faith was never fully extinguished.

characters.name: Sorcerer
characters.backstory: A scholar of the Dragon Archives, in a Lothric that no longer wants scholars.

characters.name: Pyromancer
characters.backstory: A wanderer from Izalith who carries a flame in the palm and no fear of the dark.

bosses.name: Iudex Gundyr
bosses.title: Champion of Ash
bosses.lore: The first champion, still half-buried in the Cemetery of Ash, an Unkindled that never left his post. Something far uglier rises from his back.

bosses.name: Vordt of the Boreal Valley
bosses.title: The Frozen Hound-Knight
bosses.lore: A Lord's guardian turned monster, with a hammer for a mace and a frozen breath that rattles through the High Wall.

bosses.name: Dancer of the Boreal Valley
bosses.title: The Dancer in Ash
bosses.lore: An undying dancer whose steps are a ritual, and whose twin swords hold the last of the fire. She was a lord's keeper long before the flame began to fade.

bosses.name: Dragonslayer Armour
bosses.title: Guardian of the Cathedral
bosses.lore: A giant armoured guardian of the Cathedral of the Deep, whose hollow helm hides only the will to slay. It is the strongest knight Lothric ever made.

npcs.name: The Fire Keeper
npcs.quote: Ashen One, hearken my words. Together we shall kindle the flame.

npcs.name: Andre of Astora
npcs.quote: Hmph. I've been at this since before any of you were born.

npcs.name: Ludleth of Courland
npcs.quote: Aye, I'll trade. One sip of the Lords' ash and it's yours.

npcs.name: Yuria of Londor
npcs.quote: A kindred spirit, then. I shall keep you company.
